question: Spec dispatch (nen/decisions.json row spec-dispatch; dowsing-chain § 8): is each dispatch of a spec slice a G1 gate you approve, or does the typed wave suffice?

options.label: Typed wave suffices (Recommended)
options.consequence: Confirm: no per-dispatch gate; the typed dowsing-chain dispatch wave is the go, and an idle run holds it

options.label: G1 per dispatch
options.consequence: Amend: every dispatch waits for your approval (restore the G1 claim)
